ear Bill,

IPI is organizing our conference on a global responses to future pandemics. The idea is coincident I believe,
with your thinking on this matter, Chancellor Angela Merkel certainly agrees. recently. Confirmed speakers are
Margaret Chan, Peter Maurer, and Michael Moller (head of the UN Office in Geneva).

I believe that the threat of future pandemics will be one of the most serious future challenges to the multilateral
system and to mankind. I think the platform for you to give the keynote address would be unique . at

The conference will be strictly policy oriented, with a goal of setting up possible new mechanisms for resilience
and the management of future crises. The conference will be held on September 11-12, at the Palais de Nations
in Geneva on September 12th.

The event is fully financed . If you would give the keynote, many of the health movers will be in attendance.

I hope your foundation is please with its cooperation with IPI . We were very pleased with the recent meetings
that took place in Seattle with the team, and in New York and Geneva with Christopher Elias. And I am looking
forward to future cooperation in multiple fields.

If you would have the time, I think it would be useful if we could meet in the near future. I will be in Europe for
the next two weeks, and could meet at your convenience

Warmest,
Terje
